Begin your answer with exactly one line: "Verdict: yes", "Verdict: no", or "Verdict: cannot tell from this trace". Then answer the question.
answer:

Across the whole trace (offsets 0–30,657.9 ms), interrupt handling on CPU 3—the CPU where render ran for virtually all its CPU time—used **0.0197%** of the CPU, well below the **10%** threshold. Its peak was **0.0278%** over the reported 0–30,657.9 ms stretch.
